pages.heading: Raccoon
pages.body: Forests and plains. Can steal food from containers. Give a chicken egg near water so it can wash it to tame it. Breed with bread; carpets make removable bandanas.

pages.heading: Raccoon (cont.)
pages.body: Its tail makes a Frontiersman's Cap for faster sneaking. Glow Berries can bond one with a following Blue Jay.
